title: Ningsih: Dendam Arwah Penghuni Pabrik
overview: Based on Novel by Teguh Faluvie.

title: Ibra Menembus Langit
overview: Before entering the Islamic boarding school, Ibra's teenage life changes drastically after a traumatic event hits his family. Trapped in a vortex of anger and deep loss, Ibra must endure a heavy emotional journey to make peace with destiny. Supported by his family and friends, Ibra struggles to heal his inner wounds and rediscover his purpose in life.

title: Banyak Anak Banyak Rejeki yang Harus Dicari
overview: Gravedigger Babe Rojali lives in poverty with his wife Siti Juleha and their three children. During a heavy rain, as he was busy bailing out water from his leaky house, a neighborhood watchman arrived and asked him to dig a grave that night, at the request of the neighborhood head. Reluctantly, he set out, accompanied by his younger brother Abdul. While digging the grave, Babe Rojali prayed and asked God to make him rich. That prayer seemed to be answered because he later found a lump of gold in the ground of the grave he had dug. From that moment on, Babe Rojali’s life changed completely.

title: Red Zone: Dead City
overview: Two weeks after a devastating zombie outbreak destroys their home, a resilient young woman and her band of refugees flee to a neighboring safe zone, only to be hunted by paranoid locals convinced the outsiders are harboring the lethal virus.

title: 23 Seconds
overview: A former Silat champion enters amateur MMA to honor his brother lost in a Phuket Tsunami, while underground Muay Thai fighter Somchai is chosen to represent Thailand at the world championship in Jakarta. Two warriors, who will prevail?

title: Sebelum Tiga Puluh
overview: Presents stories of people’s lives before the age of thirty. Dreams, life’s pressures, and the choices that often come our way—we all go through them, a process of struggling, doubting, falling, and then getting back up again.

title: Mate's Rate
overview: After getting fired, Uji, a graphic designer, teams up with her three closest friends to start a creative agency. Amid client demands, family expectations, and friendship dilemmas, she hopes this could be a new beginning. But deeper she goes, the more she realizes: every relationship has its price, friendship included.
